dialogs.text: One sugar sculpture, please.
Here you go. Eat it quick once you open it, alright?
(Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Lauma</color>'s interested in sugar sculptures...?)
Could you make me a few, please, Miss Hunajatta?
No problem, Miss Lauma. Did the kids like the batch you brought back last time?
Hehe, that they did. In fact, some of them could only be convinced to ruin their beautiful treats once they had almost melted away.
I see... You know what? I'll bring my tools and go to you all next time. You know, set up a live station for the kids.
Ah, that would be lovely. The children will be so happy.
Oh, and uh, guess we're getting off topic, huh? I'll go make your sugar sculptures. Once they're done, I'll have someone deliver it to the Scions.
But before that... Hehe, I have a good idea~
One moment, Miss Lauma. I'll whip something special up for you.
(Might <color=#FFCC33FF>Flins</color> have an interest in sugar sculptures...?)
Miss Hunajatta. If I might impose, would you make me a sugar sculpture?
Oh, sure. You're... Flins, the Ratnik, am I right? I think I've seen you in our store before.
Indeed you have. I do sometimes swing by to purchase supplies. It is an honor and a privilege to be remembered so.
As for today, I just happened to be passing through when I witnessed your sugar-shaping mastery.
And after much consideration, I decided that I must have you sculpt me a serving.
Oh, please, no need to be so polite. You're embarrassing me here~
Just hold on a moment, one serving coming right up.
Hmm. Perhaps we should do something special for our good Ratnik...
(Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Aino</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)
Hiya Boss! One sugar sculpture, please!
Oh, Miss Aino! It's been a while~
Hehe. Rolled into town to help fix some stuff. Thought I'd pop by and snag some candy!
Also, Ineffa isn't around, so... make me a few extras, would ya? And make 'em extra sweet!
Well, sure... but you gotta brush your teeth once you're done eating, alright?
Yeah, yeah, I know, I know. I always brush my teeth after eating candy! My teeth are super dee duper great!
Haha... Hold on a moment, then...
(Might <color=#FFCC33FF>Ineffa</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)
Excuse me. Could I trouble you to make me one sugar sculpture?
Sure. For Miss Aino, I presume?
Negative. Aino requested that I come and buy myself a beautiful sugar sculpture.
According to her, this is part of my "social activity" training, which will make shopping more convenient in future.
I see~
Though I do not understand. I do not require this much sugar intake.
I suspect that Aino may wind up eating this sculpture in secret.
Miss Hunajatta, could you construct a sugar sculpture with smaller dimensions?
Aino loves candy, but I believe she should eat somewhat less.
Don't worry, I've got this... Now, let me see...
(Might <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)
I'll have one sugar sculpture, Hunajatta.
Lady Nefer, what an unexpected surprise. What brings you here today?
I find getting out and taking a walk every now and then is good for both body and mind.
Besides, having something sweet helps my thought process.
Wonderful! Give me a minute, I'll rustle you one up right away!
Many thanks. And while I'm here, take this money. The next time Jahoda comes by...
Make her an extra-large one? Make it even sweeter?
...Give the money to her.
And tell her, "Nefer's paying double, so once you're done lazing around, head back. And grab a sugar sculpture for the boss while you're at it."
(Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)
An extra-large one, please, boss.
It's not your first time here, Jahoda. You know the size of our sugar sculptures is fixed.
Come on, everything's turning up roses today! Hurry it up, just a little bigger than usual.
Turning up roses? Your commission went well then, I suppose?
Hehehe, of course. Just a simple escort mission. Easy peasy, done and dusted.
Not a single hair harmed on the client's head, not a single scratch found on the cargo.
Okay, I'm done talking. Speed it along, let's get that sugar sculpture on the go, I'll take it to go.
No problem. Give me a moment...
(Claim a Moon-Prayer Night Sugar Sculpture)
Here's your Sugar Sculpture. Happy Moon-Prayer Night!
(Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Columbina</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)
Sugar sculpture... I think I've tried it before. Could you make one for me?
No problem! Just wait a moment.
(Hmm... Have I seen this girl somewhere in town before...?)
(Wow! She looks so full of anticipation... Ah, think, think! What style would suit her best?)
(Go with your instinct... follow your gut... okay, okay! I've got this!)
Umm... I'm done. Take a look — do you like it?
It looks great. Thank you.
Hehe, I'm glad you like it.
(Yes, my instinct was right — this light, airy style suits such a light, airy kid!)
Mmm, it's really tasty too...
Could you make two more? I want to take them back for the kuuhenki to try as well.
For... the kuuhenki too? Well, I could, but I don't have enough ingredients...
Then I'll come back tomorrow and bring them with me.
No problem... See you then...
(Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)
Well, since I'm already here... Hello, one sugar sculpture, please!
Oh! Could you make it a bit smaller? I'm worried something might come up and I won't be able to finish it in one go...
No problem at all! Don't worry — even the small ones taste just as good.
Still, you Lightkeepers really do have your hands full... even a sugar sculpture might go unfinished.
Um... Ahaha... Well, it's not just the duties. Sometimes it's because I run into someone who needs help.
You know how it is — half-eaten sugar sculptures are hard to keep. All I can really do is wrap it up in cloth and tuck it into my pocket...
But by the time I'm done helping and take it back out, the whole thing's melted away...
I see... Let me think. A small sugar sculpture... hmm...
Got it! I can make a small sculpture with multiple flavors!
Layer this flavor on the bottom... then this one on top...
All right! Here you go, a mini, multi-flavor sugar sculpture! Does this suit your needs, dear customer?
Ah, it's perfect! Thank you, Ms. Hunajatta!
Oh, don't mention it. I may not be able to help you Ratniki with your work... but if you ever want sugar sculptures, I can make as many as you like!
That's our job. You're too kind, Ms. Hunajatta... I'll take my leave now, there's still work waiting.
Okay, take care! And next time you want a sugar sculpture, just come straight over!
